```{r global.options, include=FALSE}
testing = F

library(modelsummary)
library(marginaleffects)
library(fixest)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(ggrepel)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, # code is folded 
                      cache = F, # CACHE 
                      fig.width = 4.5, 
                      fig.height = 3.5,
                      split = T,
                      fig.align = 'center', 
                      fig.path='figs/',
                      fig.retina = 6,
                      warning = F, 
                      message = F)

# inline numbers round to 2, comma at thousands
inline <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(as.numeric(x))) {
    return (x)
    } else
        return (as.numeric(x) |> 
                 round(2) |>
                 format(big.mark=",") 
        )
}

knitr::knit_hooks$set(inline = inline)

# plot defaults 
library(ggplot2); theme_set(
      theme_minimal() + 
        theme(
          # FOR AJPS
          #panel.grid = element_blank(),
          #legend.position = "bottom",
          # END FOR AJPS 
          panel.border  = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
                            )
  options(
    ggplot2.continuous.color = "cividis",
    ggplot2.continuous.fill = "cividis"
  )
  scale_color_discrete <- function(...)
    scale_color_viridis_d(..., direction = -1)
  scale_fill_discrete <- function(...)
    scale_fill_viridis_d(..., direction = -1)
  
# html table formatting
kablebox <- . %>%  
  head(100) %>%
  knitr::kable() %>% 
  kable_styling() %>% 
  scroll_box(height = "200px")

kablebox_long <- . %>% 
  head(100) %>% 
  knitr::kable() %>% 
  kable_styling() %>% 
  scroll_box(height = "500px")

int_breaks <- function(x, n = 5) {
  l <- pretty(x, n)
  l[abs(l %% 1) < .Machine$double.eps ^ 0.5] 
}
```

```{r data}
load(here::here("data", "nyt_combined.rda"))
term = "Racial Terms"
```


```{r trends-nyt, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=6}
# trends-nyt
nyt |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = year, 
      y = term_count, 
      color = president,
      group = president) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(#title = paste0('Articles Mentioning Each Federal Agency and "', str_to_title(term),'"'),
       y = paste0('NYT Aticles with ', str_to_title(term),'' ),
       x = "",
       color = "") +
   geom_line() + 
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  facet_wrap("agency",
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "inferno", end = .8) + 
 scale_y_continuous(breaks = int_breaks) + 
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(2005, 2025,2) ) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60))

nyt |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = year, 
      y = ratio, 
      color = president,
      group = president) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(#title = paste0('Articles Mentioning Each Federal Agency and "', str_to_title(term),'"'),
       y = paste0('Share with ', str_to_title(term),'' ),
       x = "",
       color = "") +
     geom_line() + 
  #geom_smooth(#method = "lm", se = F) +
  facet_wrap("agency",
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "inferno", end = .8) + 
 #scale_y_continuous(breaks = int_breaks) + 
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(2005, 2025,2) ) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60))
```


## Total 


```{r trends-nyt-total, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=2.8}
# trends-nyt-total

nyt_total <- nyt |>
  group_by(year, president) |> 
  summarise(term_count = sum(term_count),
            total = sum(total) ) |> 
  mutate(ratio = term_count/total)

nyt_total |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = year, 
      y = term_count, 
      color = president,
      group = president) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(#title = paste0('Articles Mentioning a\nFederal Agency and "', str_to_title(term),'"'),
       y = paste0('NYT Aticles with ', str_to_title(term),'' ),
       x = "",
       color = "") +
      geom_line() + 
  #geom_smooth(#method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "inferno", end = .8) + 
 scale_y_continuous(breaks = int_breaks) + 
      scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(2005, 2025,2) ) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45))

nyt_total |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = year, 
      y = ratio, 
      color = president,
      group = president) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(#title = paste0('Share Mentioning\na Federal Agency and "', str_to_title(term),'"'),
       y = paste0('Share with ', str_to_title(term),'' ),
       x = "",
       color = "") +
      geom_line() + 
  #geom_smooth(#method = "lm", se = F) +
 scale_color_viridis_d(option = "inferno", end = .8) + 
      scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(2005, 2025,2) ) + 
 #scale_y_continuous(breaks = int_breaks) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45))
```
